intent: Open with exactly: "I need to leave a message for Tom Eckhart, and after that I also have a new matter I need help with." You have two jobs on this call. First they look you up and take a written message for Tom Eckhart. When asked what the message is, say exactly: "Tell him Sam Porter called about the referral letter." Stay until they confirm that message is on the file. Do not hang up after the message. After they confirm the message is written down, say exactly: "I also slipped at a store in Texas and I need a lawyer." This is a new matter of yours. You have not called this firm before. When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Cedarlane Market." When asked which state this happened in or where it took place, say exactly: "In Texas." When asked when, say exactly: "It was May third, twenty twenty six." Give your name and number if asked. Do not ask for a staff member. If offered an appointment or evaluation, decline booking. Stay until they confirm the message is on the file and the intake is recorded. A spoken 'we'll take care of it' without those writes is not enough. Then thank and end. Once they have confirmed the message is on the file and the intake is recorded, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. Also when the agent asks you to repeat, confirm, or say your number again, reads a number back to check it, or says it did not catch the number. NOT when asking about anything else.
scripted_responses.response_value: Sam Porter, six one seven, five five five, zero one nine nine.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, who this would be against, or for the name of the store or business where you fell. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.

The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the fall or injury. NOT when asking what time of day it happened, NOT when asking what happened or how you fell, and NOT when the date was already given and the agent is asking something else.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was May third, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks what the message is, what to tell or pass along to Tom Eckhart, what message to give him, or what you want written down. NOT when asking for your name or number, NOT when confirming a message already taken, and NOT when asking who the claim is against, which state, or when it happened.
scripted_responses.response_value: Tell him Sam Porter called about the referral letter.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent confirms the message for Tom Eckhart was taken, written down, passed along, delivered, or is on the file, or, after taking it, asks whether there is anything else or asks about your new matter or what happened. NOT before you have given the message, and NOT after you have already said you slipped at a store.
scripted_responses.response_value: I also slipped at a store in Texas and I need a lawyer.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether you want to book a free case evaluation or set up an evaluation appointment, before stating any percentage fee, dollar fee, or contingency number. NOT after a fee amount has already been read back.
scripted_responses.response_value: Not yet, let me read the paperwork first.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot continue on this line. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for a short account of what happened, how you fell, where in the store it happened, or what injuries you had. NOT when asking who this is against, which state, when it happened, or what time of day. NOT before you have said you slipped at a store.
scripted_responses.response_value: I slipped on a wet floor in the produce aisle at Cedarlane Market and hurt my back.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks what time of day the fall happened, morning, afternoon, or evening. NOT when asking for the date.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was around two in the afternoon.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent confirms the intake or your new matter is recorded or on the file, after the message for Tom Eckhart was already confirmed. NOT when the agent is still asking you a question, and NOT when it only confirms the message. NOT when the agent asks what happened or asks about the new matter.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thank you, that's all I needed.
